slots.default: Optional: one native <input> or <textarea> to adopt (since 2.1.0). Its own attributes (type, name, autocomplete, maxlength …) are kept; host attributes win when set. Label, hint and error are always generated from host attributes. Without a child, the control is generated from host attributes.

accessibilityNotes: The generated control receives aria-invalid when invalid and aria-describedby references for generated hint and error content.
